objective.text: Use Skip to delete obsolete work without consuming a failed-job path.

difficulty.rationale: Treat an intentionally unnecessary operation as skipped work rather than a failed attempt.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A queued job returns [Skip::when(true)] from middleware(). What happens to its normal handle call and failure state when processed?

options.text: handle is skipped, and the job is deleted without being marked failed.
options.rationale: Skip short-circuits the processing pipeline; the queued handler then completes normal cleanup rather than invoking failure handling.

options.text: The job is released repeatedly until the condition becomes false.
options.rationale: Skip does not use release as a waiting mechanism for this condition.
options.misconception: Skip does not use release as a waiting mechanism for this condition.

options.text: The job is marked failed with a maximum-attempts exception.
options.rationale: Intentional skipping does not itself constitute an exhausted-attempt failure.
options.misconception: Intentional skipping does not itself constitute an exhausted-attempt failure.

options.text: handle runs once and the result is discarded.
options.rationale: The middleware prevents the downstream handler from being invoked.
options.misconception: The middleware prevents the downstream handler from being invoked.
